about: VisionClaw's third held-out evaluation set for the words of the final answer: written on 2026-11-19, after the second held-out set's run showed a model's answer dropping a word it copied from what was looked up ("within 30 for a full refund", "from nine to"), and before anything was done about it, and before anything was run on it. Every request asks for a fact of several words that the answer must give exactly as it was looked up: from the web page Example Shop, from the window, from NVDA, from Windows and from the library, in a blind person's casual words. Never write a rule from its misses. Same form and the same facts of the stand-ins as answers.json. Never take a request of it into known.json, a pattern's test or a note.

requests.request: how long have I got to send something back
do they give you all your money back or just some of it
which days of the week are they open
what hours does this shop keep
what sort of stuff do they sell here
what build of windows have I got
which windows release am I running
what's the key for the options button in this game
how do I get out of this game from the keyboard
how does buying and selling work in space trader
which braille table is set right now
which speech synthesizers have I got installed
which of my addons are switched off
what reads out the line I'm on
